batch.topic: A group draws the line at sharing a private draft outside the team; boundary refers to acceptable action, not a drawing task.
A team is back to square one after an assumption fails, but retained notes are still available; idiom does not imply all records vanished.
A writer says an apparent contradiction is a red herring in a discussion; it is a distraction, not a fish or an answer to the contradiction.
A person brushes up on a language before a trip; revising knowledge is not physically brushing an object.
